trap.label: expected ≠ esperar
trap.wrong: I'm expected your answer by Friday.
trap.right: I'm expecting your answer by Friday.
trap.why: O verbo expect não é "esperar" no sentido de aguardar com be expected. Be expected to = a gente espera que; expecting = aguardando.

mcq.why: be supposed to = expectativa ou regra.

opts: Staff are expected to wear ID.

fix.wrong: You are suppose to sign here.
fix.right: You are supposed to sign here.

fix.wrong: They were suppose to meet at six.
fix.right: They were supposed to meet at six.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com be supposed to: “You must be here at nine.”
rewrite.answer: You are supposed to be here at nine.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com be expected to: “They expect us to be quiet.”
rewrite.answer: We are expected to be quiet.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “She is supposed to call.”
